world_current_description: What has my attention right now.
home_lead: I build digital products and the systems that help good ideas survive contact with reality.
home_section_one_body: I like clear thinking, small feedback loops, and software that respects the people using it. The useful solution usually starts by understanding the real constraint.
home_section_two_body: Orbit is a quiet map of my work, current interests, and side quests. Every destination remains a real page, even without the visual system around it.
current_lead: A short-lived snapshot of the questions and craft receiving most of my attention right now.
current_section_one_body: I am exploring dependable AI-assisted product workflows, from shaping a useful problem to shipping software that can be understood and maintained.
current_section_two_body: The recurring theme is leverage without losing judgment: better tools, tighter feedback, and deliberate decisions about where automation should stop.
workbench_lead: The place for software, product experiments, and lessons gathered while turning uncertain ideas into working systems.
workbench_section_one_body: Start with the user journey, make state explicit, and keep the architecture proportional to the problem. Accessibility and performance are part of the design, not a final pass.
workbench_section_two_body: TypeScript and modern web platforms are frequent companions, but the stack follows the job. I value strong types, observable behavior, automated checks, and small deployable changes.
workbench_projects_body: Veo explores AI-assisted video workflows, kijk is a product-focused software project, and Orbit is the website you are navigating now. Their source and progress are public on GitHub.
side_quests_lead: The interests outside the main route keep curiosity in motion and make the return trip more interesting.
side_quests_section_one_body: Hiking and training provide a useful change of scale: steady progress, real terrain, and fewer notifications.
side_quests_section_two_body: Games, LEGO, and small creative projects are laboratories for systems thinking, storytelling, and the pleasure of making something just because it is fun.
comms_lead: Good conversations usually begin with a concrete idea, an interesting problem, or a shared curiosity.
comms_section_one_body: The most direct channel is email. You can also find my public work on GitHub or connect with me on LinkedIn.
comms_section_two_body: A short note about what you are building, what is difficult, and why it matters is always a helpful way to begin.
